newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Trans Hex Int'l lists on Toronto bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trans Hex Int'l lists on Toronto bourse.

text.p: Diamond exploration and development company Trans Hex International, a subsidiary of the Trans Hex Group, announced its common shares were due to begin trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Thursday.
THI also said it had filed and obtained receipts for a final prospectus for the qualification of its common shares and common share purchase warrants.

The shares and warrants are issuable upon the exercise of 6.55 million previously issued special warrants and a new issue of up to 1.1 million common shares at a price of C$2.75 per share for total gross proceeds of C$18 million.
The new issue will be completed pursuant to an agreement with Canaccord Capital Corp, which has agreed to act as agent in connection with the offering, THI said.
The offering is expected to be completed in two closings, the first of which is to occur on Thursday.
Canaccord, together with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Canada Ltd, is underwriting the special warrant financing.
